<div class="card-body">
'''Don't Get Cocky''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">まだ気を抜くな</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。１：ルークとハンが一緒に戦闘に参加している時に使う。戦闘運命数を２枚引いて足す。２：相手が星系で戦闘を宣言した直後に使う。その星系のタイ・ファイターを１機選んで、破壊（ロスト）する。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-76o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ルークとハンは見事に連携し、タイ・ファイターを四連レーザー砲で撃退して、ミレニアム・ファルコンを守りぬいた。「いい腕だ。だが、まだ気は抜けねえぞ。」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Don't get cocky.

'''Card text:''' Choose one. If Luke and Han are in a battle together, add two battle destiny. Just after the opponent initiates a battle at a system, choose one TIE fighter there to be lost.

'''Lore:''' Luke and Han teamed up and drove off TIE fighters with the quad laser cannons, saving the Millennium Falcon. “Nice shooting. But don't get cocky.”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Option 2 names タイ・ファイター; the English names TIE/ln.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Don't Get Cocky]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
